    height = len(grid)
    width = len(grid[0])
    bottom = max(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(row))

    for r, row in enumerate(grid):

        for c, value in enumerate(row):
            if value:
                nc = c - shift
                if 0 <= nc < width:

    return out
'''
